svg.title: AI Incident Investigator — MVP architecture
svg.desc: React and Nginx send investigation requests to FastAPI. Sequential collectors gather JSONL logs, historical Prometheus samples and current Actuator snapshots. Combined evidence optionally passes through OpenAI and output validation; the report retains evidence on failure. A separate opt-in evaluation pipeline uses synthetic recorded fixtures and human review.

text.tspan: MVP architecture / Request-driven investigation with evidence-backed analysis
Same service for the HTTP API and evaluation runner
Sequential collection · partial results keep explicit data gaps
Filters service, environment and incident time window
Evidence references physical JSONL line numbers
Queries historical samples with fixed PromQL
Current snapshots, not historical incident data
Retrieves current application identity and health
Records observation time and snapshot limitations
Original observations and evidence IDs are preserved.
Traces are explicitly reported as unavailable in MVP.
Log reads, metric queries and Actuator calls
are initiated by an investigation request.
Bounded input and output · server-side key
Keep original evidence if analysis fails.
Rendered in UI · downloadable as JSON
Recorded telemetry is deterministic. Model conclusions still require human review; automated remediation is outside the MVP.
